audience: Mexican small and mid-size businesses who run sales, stock and invoicing in Bind ERP

useCases.title: Find overdue invoices and unpaid amounts
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices with total, payments received, credit notes and expiration date, then works out the open balance per client.

useCases.title: Find products that are low in stock
useCases.text: The AI reads the stock of every product in one warehouse, filtered for example to fewer than 5 units, with value and quantities on orders.

useCases.title: Review orders and quotes of a client
useCases.text: The AI finds a client and lists their sales orders and quotes with date, status and total, and opens one with its lines.

useCases.title: Check purchase orders to suppliers
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase orders with quantity ordered and still missing, and opens one with the quantities received.

useCases.title: Add a prospect and keep a comment
useCases.text: The AI checks the prospects first, then creates a prospect, and adds a comment to a record such as a prospect, client or order. A comment cannot be removed.

useCases.title: Add a client
useCases.text: The AI checks the client list for the RFC, then creates a customer record with credit terms. The RFC must be valid for the tax authority.
